messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: customer NebulaHealth (dedicated pool / VPC) — observability gap detected for tenant-9876. Severity: P2. Assigned: @Samir Patel

Samir Patel: paging — NebulaHealth oncall flagged missing traces + empty spans for tenant-9876 since ~08:12 UTC. Grafana shows p95 tokenization latency spike and zero spans emitted to our trace sharder. customers reporting degraded trace timelines. pinging infra + SRE. @Kira can you take forwarder/auth checks?

Kira Nguyen: on it. first pass: could be forwarder IAM role expiry or forwarder agent crash. did NebulaHealth recently rotate their forwarder credentials? @Priya do we have a recent rotation event in the audit log?

Priya Das: checking audit logs now. I see a key rotation event for nebula-health-forwarder on 2026-02-27 08:05 UTC (service principal rotation). token refresh looked successful for most tenants, but tenant-9876 shows repeated 403 from our forwarder-proxy between 08:10-08:14.

Marco Alvarez: confirmed: traces for tenant-9876 show ingestion errors: "403 Forbidden from forwarder-proxy (missing role:forwarder.write)". Logs: ```json
{"ts":"2026-02-27T08:11:02Z","tenant":"tenant-9876","err":"403: forbidden"}
```

Nora Blake: that smells like a delegated-role mismatch in the VPC forwarder. NebulaHealth uses per-tenant forwarder roles mapped via our role-delegation service. If the delegation entry was not updated during rotation, that tenant loses write perms.

Samir Patel: good call. Kira, can you validate the role-mapping table for nebula-health-forwarder and tenant-9876? If broken, can we temporarily create a passthrough ACL to restore traces while we fix delegation? Need mitigation before customer impact escalates.

Kira Nguyen: running lookup: `curl -s https://controlplane/internal/role-map?forwarder=nebula-health-forwarder` -> returning mapping list. For tenant-9876 entry I see stale ARN: `arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/nebula-forwarder-old` which no longer exists. Oops. I can patch to point to `arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/nebula-forwarder-v2` but that's risky without customer confirmation.

Priya Das: we can do short mitigation: enable temporary proxy-allowlist for nebula-health-forwarder service principal to accept writes for tenant-9876 for 30m. That avoids touching their IAM. Requires a controlplane toggle: `PATCH /internal/ingest/allowlist` with body `{tenant: "tenant-9876", principal: "nebula-health-forwarder", ttl: 1800}`. Who can approve?

Marco Alvarez: I'll approve for emergency mitigation. Deploying allowlist now. NOTE: this bypasses delegated-role enforcement for the tenant for TTL window. Audit logged and reversible.

incident-bot: Action logged: emergency-allowlist applied by Marco Alvarez at 08:22 UTC. TTL 30m.

Kira Nguyen: after apply — traces start flowing back in. I see successful 200s from forwarder-proxy for tenant-9876 at 08:23:05. Span count for the missing window is being backfilled as the forwarder retries. :white_check_mark:

Samir Patel: mitigation confirmed. Customer impact: NebulaHealth support reports partial visibility restored; gaps between 08:10-08:22 still missing but ingestion backlog being replayed. Samir -> @Nora can you coordinate with Solutions Eng to request their IAM admin patch the role mapping to `nebula-forwarder-v2` and rotate tokens with confirmation? Need a permanent fix and an RCA.

Nora Blake: I'll set up a quick bridge with NebulaHealth SREs. Drafting comms: "We applied a temporary allowlist to restore ingested traces; we need update to your forwarder role ARN to avoid recurrence." I'll include logs and the exact failing ARN.

Priya Das: tracking follow-ups: create incident ticket INC-NEB-9876-OBS with fields: customer=NebulaHealth, tenant=tenant-9876, mitigation=temporary-allowlist, followup=role-map update, postmortem required. Assign to Kira/Nora for remediation, Marco for revert/cleanup.

Marco Alvarez: scheduling cleanup job to revoke allowlist after TTL and to re-run the backfill check. Will post status here when TTL removed and when backfill complete.

Samir Patel: handing off to night oncall for watch and comms. @Kira @Nora will own the permanent remediation tomorrow. If anything spikes >P1, page me immediately. Otherwise, keep this thread updated.

incident-bot: Handoff: oncall-night starting 20:00 UTC assigned to @Kira Nguyen.

Kira Nguyen: ack. leaving notes: how to reproduce:
1) `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/nebula-forwarder-old --duration-seconds 900` -> will fail if ARN gone
2) check forwarder-proxy logs: `kubectl logs forwarder-proxy -n nebula-health | grep tenant-9876`
3) to rollback temporary allowlist: `DELETE /internal/ingest/allowlist?tenant=tenant-9876&principal=nebula-health-forwarder`

Samir Patel: thanks team. I'll update customer slack channel with a short note: restore in progress, temporary mitigation applied, full RCA & follow-up ticket ETA tomorrow. :heart:
